name: B10-0258/2026 (ECR) – Situation of women and girls in Afghanistan following the Taliban’s adoption of the Criminal Procedure Code for Courts
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the situation of women and girls in Afghanistan following the Taliban’s adoption of the Criminal Procedure Code for Courts
part_text:
The European Parliament condemns a new set of court rules adopted by the Taliban in Afghanistan in January 2026. The Parliament says these rules make discrimination against women and girls worse and also harm religious minorities. It calls on the Taliban to scrap all laws that discriminate and to restore women's access to education, work, healthcare and justice. It also asks the European Union to make sure aid reaches Afghan women and girls directly.

- The Taliban are urged to repeal all discriminatory laws and restore women's rights.
- Aid from the European Union should reach Afghan women and girls directly.
- The Parliament wants abuses documented and the Taliban held accountable.
